This pathway implies a possible mechanism where prostaglandin D2 may modulate the activity of lafutidine, which then affects the receptor. The evidence suggests a chain of molecular interactions that could contribute to the regulation of the receptor, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
